description: This file defines the Questionnaire class in the Goteo project, which manages questionnaire data, retrieval, storage, and associated questions within the application's model layer.

classes.name: Questionnaire
classes.description: A model class representing a questionnaire, providing methods for retrieving, saving, and analyzing questionnaire data, along with managing related questions and metadata.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns an array mapping questionnaire type labels to their corresponding class types.

methods.name: getQuestionTypeClass
methods.description: Resolves and returns the class type for a given question type, handling legacy namespaces.

methods.name: hasOldTypeNamespace
methods.description: Checks if a question type belongs to an old namespace, indicating legacy types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a questionnaire by ID, including its associated questions, or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: getByMatcher
methods.description: Retrieves a questionnaire linked to a specific matcher ID, including its questions.

methods.name: getByChannel
methods.description: Retrieves a questionnaire associated with a specific channel ID, including its questions.

methods.name: getMaxScore
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum attainable score for the questionnaire.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the questionnaire; manages related matcher and channel associations.

methods.name: isAnswered
methods.description: Determines if a given project has answered the questionnaire.

methods.name: removeLang
methods.description: Removes language-specific content from all questions in the questionnaire.

methods.name: getLangsGroupPercent
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of translation completeness across related questions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates questionnaire data; currently always returns true.

methods.name: hasQuestionsToShow
methods.description: Checks if the questionnaire has questions that are not hidden and should be displayed.
